source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The added reply test checks the full message paragraphs separately from a selected text range. The current selected-text task creates the selection through SpecialPowers.spawn in the message content browser and asserts the quoted text. These assertions do not directly check link targets, form removal or embedded-image fidelity merely because those appear in the fixture. The commit adds a test before a separate Gecko repair; test presence is not proof that the bug was fixed. Bug context has unavailable comments, so this is source-only evidence. No browser task ran.
title: HTML reply tests distinguish full content from selected text
